title: 第9章 狼妖配种白氏后人第10章 为虎作伥修士失踪
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
又过了半日。
陈耀东带着情根符回来。
因为黑魔教的事情，陈启山再一次召集众人，这其中也包括第二代的长子，清河典史“陈耀文”
陈启山的意思只有两个。
第一，家族修士这阵子能苟则苟。
第二，衙门里多拉点兵马巡视自家地盘。
除此之外，也没有别的好办法。
陈耀东知道仙门里有一种专门追踪黑魔教的灵符，名为“黑魔符”
但是这属于仙门长老自己的作品，一张就得一百块灵石往上。
显然，他们家是没这么阔绰的。
其余三大仙族也不见得愿意出这笔灵石，到时候战利品得上缴暂且不提，还有可能会因此触怒黑魔教，给自家惹来麻烦。
……
后院里。
陈耀东将“情根符”
交给陈景安，并且指挥着他把“情根符”
植入狼妖的体内。
随着一抹灵光闪过，昏死的狼妖瞬间惊醒。
它挣扎着就要逃走，但是身体上出现了一条条由符文凝结而成的锁链，直接将狼妖的力量给封住。
同时，它原本凶狠的眸子，豁然间变得有些呆滞。
陈耀东解释道：“这情根符可以让狼妖一直处于发情的状态，而且能锁住力量，你不用担心他能伤到你。”

陈景安点了点头：“侄儿明白。”
“只是有点可惜了，这狼妖本身应该快要突破到练气六层了，可惜植入了情根符，这辈子再没有更进一步的可能，而且寿数也会减半。”
“你争取这些年多给它配点，至少要把情根符的本钱给赚回来。”
陈耀东又交代了一番，然后返回老爷子的住处。
二人不知道商量了什么。
次日一早，陈耀东就再次离开，返回仙门了。
陈景安也随即从家族控制的马行里，挑了十几匹母马。
那狼妖起初看向他的眼神依旧凶狠，甚至还咬死了两匹配种的马。
但是在情根符的影响下。
它最终还是逃脱不了“真香”
的命运，撑不过一天就能与马儿们打成一片。
……
日子一天天过去。
content_en:
Another half day passed.
Chen Yaodong came back with the Love Root Talisman.
Because of the Black Demon Sect, Chen Qishan once again summoned everyone, including the eldest son of the second generation, Qinghe Dianshi "Chen Yaowen"
Chen Qishan only has two meanings.
First, the monks in the family are very strict these days.
Second, recruit more soldiers and horses in the Yamen to patrol their own territory.
Apart from this, there is no other good way.
Chen Yaodong knew that there was a kind of talisman in the Immortal Sect that specifically tracked the Black Demon Cult, called the "Black Demon Talisman"
But this is the work of the immortal sect elder himself, and one piece costs a hundred spiritual stones upwards.
Obviously, their family is not that wealthy.
The other three major immortal clans may not be willing to pay for this spiritual stone. Not to mention that the loot will have to be handed over at that time, it may also offend the Black Demon Sect and cause trouble for themselves.
…
In the backyard.
Chen Yaodong will "Love Root Talisman"
He handed it over to Chen Jingan and directed him to put the "Love Root Talisman"
Implanted into the body of the wolf demon.
With a flash of spiritual light, the unconscious wolf demon woke up instantly.
It struggled to escape, but chains formed by runes appeared on its body, directly blocking the wolf demon's power.
At the same time, its originally fierce eyes suddenly became dull.
Chen Yaodong explained: "This Love Root Talisman can keep the wolf demon in a state of estrus and lock its power. You don't have to worry about him hurting you."
Chen Jingan nodded: "My nephew understands."
"It's just a pity. The wolf demon itself should be about to break through to the sixth level of Qi training. Unfortunately, with the Love Root Talisman implanted, there is no possibility of further progress in this life, and the lifespan will be halved."
"You try to add more points to it over the years, at least to earn back the capital of the Love Root Talisman."
Chen Yaodong explained again and then returned to the old man's residence.
The two didn't know what they discussed.
Early the next morning, Chen Yaodong left again and returned to Xianmen.
Chen Jing'an also immediately selected a dozen mares from the horse shop controlled by his family.
The wolf demon looked at him with fierce eyes at first, and even killed two matching horses.
But under the influence of the Love Root Talisman.
In the end, it still can't escape the "really fragrant"
His fate was such that he could not survive more than a day to become one with the horses.
…
The days passed.
